summary_1line: Krishna reveals himself and the Pandavas to Jarasandha, condemns his capture of kings for sacrifice, and challenges him to release them or fight.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands calmly before the suspicious Jarasandha in the royal hall, revealing his identity while the disguised Pandava heroes stand beside him.
Krishna, Arjuna, and Bhima cast aside the pretense of Brahmanas and openly challenge the powerful king Jarasandha in his court.
Jarasandha sits on his throne surrounded by Magadha warriors as Krishna denounces his plan to sacrifice captive kings to Rudra.
